content:
Travel cancellation insurance, often called STORNO, needs checking against causes and expenses expressly stated in the contract. It does not promise all your money back whenever you decide not to leave. For a reservation made from Moldova, start with ticket, accommodation and package conditions, then compare proposed protection. A commercial label cannot determine the accepted reason or actual non-refundable cost for your particular booking.

GRAWE Moldova's public travel example describes cancellation expenses for listed product reasons. That local example establishes neither an identical product from every provider nor ING Broker intermediation for every situation. This article organizes documents and questions without copied financial limits or acceptance promises. The useful answer must concern the actual travellers, reservation, timing and proposed conditions rather than assumptions imported from another package.

Separate cancellation from other travel problems

Cancellation before departure, interruption after departure and a transport delay are different situations. Identify the risk and stage you want to discuss. Do not rely only on the word travel in a commercial name. Request the relevant component and the event definition in the documents you will receive. An explanation about medical help during a trip should not silently become confirmation of financial protection before departure.

A transport company's or agency's refund is a separate question from insurance. Check the direct recovery available from each reservation and the genuinely non-refundable remainder. Do not treat everything paid as an insured loss before reading commercial terms and obtaining relevant responses. Keep an actual refund distinct from a request still awaiting an answer so a working total does not misrepresent money already recovered.

Make the booking timeline clear

Record booking, each payment, insurance request and departure dates. Add when you learned about the circumstance potentially causing cancellation. Their sequence matters. A circumstance known before purchase should not be presented as a later surprise, and backdating documents is not an acceptable way to seek protection. Use the actual records rather than reconstructing convenient approximate dates or making the application appear earlier than it was.

Ask when cancellation protection can be purchased relative to the reservation and which conditions must be met. This article sets no universal number of days. A product available for a new booking is not automatically available close to departure or after a known problem. The ability to request a calculation does not establish acceptance of that circumstance; describe it accurately before expecting a contractual response.

The accepted cause matters more than the STORNO label

Request accepted events and read their definitions. Health issues, an incident at home or other circumstances can be described differently across contracts. One example does not include every similar situation. Ask who must be affected, when the event must arise and which record shows its connection with inability to travel. An answer for another traveller or period is not automatically an answer for the person making this reservation.

Personal preference, changed plans and fear of travelling are not automatically covered causes. State the actual concern before contracting. A general response that STORNO exists is insufficient. Request the relevant condition and preserve unconfirmed points. Do not replace the true reason with wording resembling a promotional example. Accurate circumstances are needed for assessment, and the programme's name alone cannot establish their eligibility.

Who is included?

A family reservation may have one payer and several travellers. Check who is insured and which people matter to the reason relied on. Payment by one spouse does not automatically include everyone. Ask about one person being unable to leave while others can still travel. A shared booking or invoice does not independently explain each participant's contractual role or the allocation of possible non-refundable expense.

For business travel, company, employee and organizer can have different roles. Prepare reservations and responsibility for expenses without unnecessarily circulating medical files inside the business. Ask how replacing a participant is assessed. A ticket-name change, voucher and final cancellation are not equivalent outcomes by default. Documents should show what actually happened to the service and money rather than calling every modification a complete loss.

Calculate actual non-refundable costs

List tickets, accommodation and other prepaid services. Beside each, record amount paid, currency, cancellation rule and any refund reply. Do not include unpurchased services or spending merely planned. Retain actual payment confirmations, not only a screenshot of an advertised price. Linking service, payment and applicable conditions helps explain the remaining cost without turning your own calculation into an insurer's accepted compensation amount.

Disclose a partial refund or future-travel credit exactly as offered and do not conceal direct recovery. Ask how the actual proposal treats taxes, commissions and unused components. A private loss calculation organizes the file but does not determine compensation. Keep supplier responses, amounts received and open requests distinguishable so an expected refund is not counted as paid or an already returned sum described as wholly outstanding.

Limits, deductible and contract currency

Compare maximum assessed amounts, per-person or per-booking limits and any deductible. The deductible is the insured's share under the conditions. A high ceiling does not remove own contributions or exclusions. Request an explanation for your booking without treating a calculation as advance claim approval.

Check document currencies and treatment of expenses paid in another currency. Do not select an arbitrary exchange rate to promise a final refund. Ask which payment evidence and date matter. Keep transaction proof, not only a screenshot of the pre-purchase price.

Keep booking records from the outset

Save confirmation, purchase-time conditions, invoices and payment evidence. Commercial webpages may change later, so retain transaction documents. Archive successive versions when reservations change. Without a timeline, explaining what was bought and which cancellation terms were accepted becomes harder.

Keep cancellation and refund correspondence, dates, responses and confirmed amounts. Do not delete an unfavourable reply after opening another request. The insurer needs the full situation. Use the agreed channel for sensitive records rather than a public post intended to hurry assessment.

When the cancellation reason arises

Promptly check policy and booking instructions and contact relevant parties. Do not wait simply to see whether the loss grows. Request a reference and document list. This article sets no single notification deadline and does not replace the contract or appropriate action in an actual emergency.

Medical documentation belongs to competent professionals. Do not request inaccurate records to fit policy wording. Keep records as received and clarify translation needs. Broker explanations help organisation but do not replace the insurer's assessment or guarantee acceptance of an expense.

Check existing protection before buying a duplicate

A package, medical policy or other contract may mention extra services. Request documents before concluding cancellation protection exists or is absent. A card or app name does not prove cover. Compare people, cause, period and limits, not merely the word insurance.

Disclose multiple contracts to the assessing provider. Do not assume the same expense can be recovered repeatedly without checking. Request document and coordination instructions rather than drawing legal conclusions from a general article. The aim is to identify the actual loss and contract able to assess it.

Separate reservations need separate service records

If flights, accommodation and transfers come from different providers, retain each contract. A hotel cancellation does not establish identical flight refunds. Ask each party and record recoverable amounts. Only then can the remaining loss be described coherently.

For group bookings, clarify allocation and payment. A joint invoice alone does not show each participant's share. If a service is changed rather than cancelled, keep the amendment and new price. Do not present a change fee as total cancellation without explaining what happened to the booking and payment.

A clear working chronology

An internal table can list date, event, document and response. Begin with booking, then payments, protection purchase, the cause and provider request. Use documented dates, not memory. This is an organisational method, not a mandatory insurer form.

Before submission, check the requested list and mark missing items. Do not invent an agency reply or convert a phone conversation into written confirmation never received. Request the missing information appropriately. Clarity can reduce follow-up questions but does not guarantee cover.

Use the administrative experience for future checklists, not as proof that the next policy is identical. Re-read the offered product and reservation. Destination, participant and purchase-method changes can require new clarification. Understand the need and documents without buying a broader promise than the written contract.

Frequently asked questions about cancellation

Can I cancel without a reason and receive everything back?

Do not assume this. The defined cause and eligible cost must be checked. A marketing name does not guarantee refunds for every change of plan.

Is visa refusal included?

Request an explicit answer for the proposed product. Do not infer inclusion from other cancellation reasons. The application, booking and event timeline and required documents matter.

Is medical travel insurance enough?

Not automatically. Some products may have a separate additional component. Distinguish medical emergencies during travel from pre-departure losses.

What does STORNO cost?

Availability and a calculation for the booking, people and conditions must be checked. This article gives no universal Moldovan tariff or confirmation of individual acceptance.

Next step
